idea-plugin.name: Verilog Toolbox
idea-plugin.description:
Verilog and SystemVerilog support for CLion: slang-server code insight, Verilator lint and simulation, Icarus Verilog testbenches and SymbiYosys formal verification in the test runner, a testbench generator, Yosys synthesis checks, GTKWave or Surfer waveforms, Quartus Prime projects and FPGA programming with openFPGALoader, with the open source tools downloadable as the OSS CAD Suite.

  • Diagnostics, navigation, hover, completion, rename and inlay hints from the slang-server language server, downloaded automatically; Verible optional for formatting and style lint
  • Verilator lint as you type: width mismatches, incomplete cases, inferred latches, multiple drivers
  • Run testbenches with Icarus Verilog from the gutter, or every testbench of a folder at once, with a pass/fail tree in the test runner
  • Or simulate with Verilator: Verilog testbenches with --timing, or C++ testbenches that drive the Verilated model, built with CMake into a project CLion loads to build, run and debug them
  • Generate Testbench for a module: instance, clock, reset and waveform dump already written
  • Check Synthesis with Yosys, for generic gates or iCE40, ECP5, Gowin and Xilinx 7-series
  • Formal verification with SymbiYosys: .sby files highlighted, each task run from the gutter as a test that passes or fails, and the counterexample opened in GTKWave or Surfer
  • Quartus Prime without its window: compile, program the device, assign pins and read the timing and resource reports, with the design of the .qsf shared with the other tools
  • Program the FPGA with openFPGALoader: build the bitstream, load it into SRAM or write it to flash, with the board and bitstream read from the project's Makefile, a live progress bar and advice when the cable or FPGA is not found
  • Gowin boards in one click without a Makefile: the bitstream is built with Yosys, nextpnr and gowin_pack, with presets for the Sipeed Tang boards, then programmed
  • GOWIN EDA without its window: build and program a .gprj project, assign pins and I/O types in a table, and read the timing, resources and messages of the last build, with the design shared with the other tools
  • Highlighting and checks for Gowin physical constraint files (.cst)
  • Open waveforms in GTKWave or Surfer, reloaded after every re-run, and add the signal at the caret
  • One .f file list defines the design for slang-server and the simulator
